biotools.summary: Hippocampome.org is a curated knowledge base of the circuitry of the hippocampus in rodents, distilling information from published evidence. The resource provides a wealth of data on neuronal properties, synaptic connectivity, and signal propagation, and supports advanced modeling of hippocampal circuits.
